title: Introducing Bookmarks on Rapid Recap
mainText:
We are thrilled to announce a new feature on Rapid Recap that will make your experience even more engaging and convenient – the Bookmark feature!

What's New?

You can now bookmark your favorite articles and easily access them later directly from your profile. This feature is designed to help you keep track of the articles that interest you the most, making it simpler to revisit important news, dive deeper into topics you love, or catch up on reading at your convenience.

How It Works

  • Save Articles: While reading any article on Rapid Recap, click the bookmark icon to save it.
  • View Bookmarked Articles: Visit your profile to find a dedicated section for all your bookmarked articles.
  • Manage Your Collection: Easily add or remove bookmarks as your interests evolve.

Why Use Bookmarks?

  • Quick Access: Instantly access the articles you find most useful or interesting.
  • Personalized Experience: Tailor your news feed to your preferences by saving articles from categories like top news, politics, technology, sports, health, and more.
  • Track Your Progress: Use your bookmarked articles as study material for quizzes to improve your Information Quotient (IQ) score and advance through our intellectual societies and circles.

We hope this new feature enhances your experience on Rapid Recap, making it easier to stay informed and engaged with the content you love.

Thank you for being a part of the Rapid Recap community. We are committed to continuously improving and bringing you the best possible experience.
